misses: What's brought you here to see me today?
Was it your own idea to come today, or did somebody send you?
Is this the first time in your life you've felt this way?
How are your spirits these days?
Have you been tearful at all?
Do you have any hobbies? Have you kept them up?
How do you spend your weekends now?
Any trouble dropping off, or is it more that you're up long before the alarm?
Do you feel refreshed when you get up in the morning?
Have people remarked that you're looking thinner?
Can you follow a film or read a page without your mind drifting off?
Do you find you get worn out easily, even by small tasks?
Has your performance at the office slipped at all?
Do you ever feel you've let people down?
Are you being hard on yourself?
Do you feel guilty about anything?
Does your head keep buzzing with thoughts when you're trying to switch off?
Is there something you keep fretting about over and over?
How do you get along with your boss?
What are the main stresses in your life right now?
Has anybody among your blood relations taken their own life or tried to?
Is there anyone at home who drinks heavily?
Do you ever feel like you just want it all to stop?
Are you having thoughts of doing something to yourself?
Do you ever go to bed hoping the next day won't come?
Has dying been on your mind at all?
Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose, like cutting or anything of that sort?
Do you intend to act on these thoughts of dying?
Has there been a time in the past when you did something to injure yourself?
Is there any chance you might do something drastic?
Have you ever taken an overdose or done anything like that?
Have you got as far as writing a note or saying goodbye to anyone?
If these feelings got worse tonight, do you think you would do anything about them?
Do you feel safe with yourself right now?
Have you decided on a day or a method?
Is there anything in your flat that you could use to harm yourself?
Do you keep any medicines in the house, even ordinary ones like paracetamol strips?
Any pesticide, rat poison, phenyl or anything like that lying around where you stay?
Do you have access to anything dangerous?
Have you been reading up on methods online?
Have you googled anything about overdoses or how much of a drug is dangerous?
Is there someone you can talk to when things get bad?
What are your reasons for living?
Is the person you share the flat with someone you can lean on?
What gives you hope, even a little?
Is there anything that makes you hold on?
How much tea or coffee do you have in a day?
Do you use anything to help you relax or cope, a peg, a cigarette, any pills?
Has your mind been playing tricks on you?
Do you ever feel that your thoughts or actions are not your own, as if some outside force is in charge?
Have you ever had a spell where you felt on top of the world and hardly needed any sleep?
Have you ever been on antidepressants or any tablets for your mood?
Have there been times when you were far more talkative, spending freely and bursting with ideas?
Have you ever had therapy or talked to anyone professionally about your feelings?
Any operations or hospital admissions in the past?
Are you in a physical relationship at present?
Are you using any birth control?
Whose idea was it to come here?
Would you call yourself a social drinker?
Tell me a little about your drinking.
How many pegs would you have on a typical day?
What do you usually have, and how much of it goes in one sitting?
Can you hold your liquor better now than you could a few years ago?
How do you feel when you get up, before you've had anything?
Have you ever passed out and found afterwards that you had bitten your tongue or wet yourself?
After going off alcohol, was there ever an episode where you didn't know where you were or what day it was?
Have you ever tried to cut down?
Do you get a strong urge for it at a particular time of day?
Do you end up having more than you planned?
Have you made promises to yourself about limiting it, and how did those go?
Have you ever driven after drinking?
Any jaundice, stomach pain or vomiting of blood ever?
Have you had your LFTs checked?
Have you ever thought your family would manage better if you weren't there?
Do you ever feel you are just a burden on everybody?
In your lowest moment recently, what was going through your mind?
Have you ever felt like not being around any more?
Have you ever done something drastic to yourself, even when drunk?
Did you ever go beyond just thinking about dying and actually take a step towards it?
If a thought of finishing yourself came, would you act on it?
Have you ever swallowed something or cut yourself in a bad moment?
Have you been saving up medicines or bought anything harmful?
What would stop you from taking your own life?
What would stop you from taking your own life?
Who is there for you at home?
Will your employer give you time off if you need to be admitted?
Tell me about your father's health.
Does drinking run in the family?
Has any close relative had liver disease?
Have you ever been to a de-addiction centre or a counsellor?
Have you ever had a stretch of days feeling extremely energetic and cheerful for no reason?
Have there been times when you were overactive, sleeping very little and still full of plans?
Do things ever get physical at home?
Is your daughter safe when you've had a few?
What are you like when you're drunk? Would your family say you change?
Has anyone at home ever been frightened of you?
Have you ever raised your hand on your child or your partner?
Do you think you have a problem with alcohol?
Would you be willing to come into hospital for a few days so we can take you off it safely?
On a scale of one to ten, how important is it to you to give this up?
The nurses tell me you've packed your bag. What's going on?
Do you feel you still need to be in hospital?
Is it noisy where your bed is?
Why do you want to go so urgently?
Is there something outside that you need to get back to?
Is there a deadline or review coming up at your company?
Some people feel embarrassed about being in a place like this. Is that part of it for you?
What do you think would have happened if your friend had not come?
How close did you come to ending your life last week?
Before your friend reached you, how long had you been up on top of the building?
I've read the notes, but I'd like to hear from you: why were you admitted?
When you're lying by yourself after lights out, where does your mind go?
Are you having any urge to do something to yourself these days?
The staff mentioned something you said yesterday that worried them. Can we talk about it?
If the thoughts came back once you were discharged, how easy would it be to get up to the top of the building?
Tell me about your living arrangements right now.
Does the building have a watchman or any barrier on the stairs to the top floor?
What has stopped you from acting on these thoughts so far?
Who are the people you would not want to hurt?
How will you cope if things get bad again once you're out?
Let me check we are on the same page: what did I just explain about the dangers of leaving early?
Do you have any worries about taking an antidepressant?
Some people fear that these medicines will change their personality. Is that a concern for you?
Do you feel you need any treatment?
Are you managing to get a proper night's rest on the ward?
Would you rather I left you in peace just now?
Was there something about the medicine that you didn't like the feel of?
Do you think there is something wrong with the tablets we are giving you?
Do you feel someone is trying to harm you?
Do you think somebody has tampered with your medicine?
Are there any disputes over property or business among your relatives?
Are your ears picking up things that others around you don't seem to notice?
Have you thought of leaving the ward without telling us?
Have you ever felt life is not worth living?
Do you feel you might need to defend yourself against anyone?
Why do you think we admitted you?
Have you tried anything with your hostel friends, like joints or pills?
Did you ever take any stuff at parties?
Do you have any physical illnesses?
